windows_added.unc: Existing writable loopback SMB share; no share, firewall, registry, or filesystem policy was created or changed.

ci.new_tests: Six automatic physical-filesystem cases; actual UNC case explicitly skips unless MIAO_TEST_UNC_ROOT names an existing writable test share.

initial_attempt.cause: The test incorrectly expected realpath casing to be canonical. Windows path resolution preserves caller casing. Removed that string comparison; the actual file-read assertion still verifies mixed-case access.

limits: This verifies Core FileSystem reads/listings, not every Git, TUI, session-storage, or transport path consumer.
UNC verification used a loopback share, not remote network latency, offline shares, or alternative SMB servers.
Product acceptance for CFG-06 remains open.
